    -- FPS

    Build an economy, then cross a bridge. That's how it always starts.

    Drag to select workers. Right-click a crystal to mine. Use Q / W / F / E / X to place a Port, Barracks, Ironnest, Central or Turret (shoots any ground or air enemy within range 12). Train marines, flamers, rocketeers, tanks and hover jets and destroy every enemy building on the far bank. On the spawn screen you can choose your faction and the enemy's: Syndicate (marines, flamers, rocketeers, tanks, hover jets) or Eirian (fairies, androids, gold crawlers).

    Smoke covers the map. Your units only see a short distance, so scout to find the enemy.

    Syndicate fields cheap, flexible troops: High-Tech units from the future.
    Eirian units cost more but are tougher, with regenerating shields: Alien tech troops and mystical space troops.
    Draugar swarm with cheap and dynamic dark magic units. Every Draugar unit regenerates their health-points.
    Umbrals strike with unyielding ghost units. High damage output with tactical upgrades.
